text: cards has one row per printing, so cards.name repeats across sets; cards.setCode = sets.code, and the set's name is sets.name.
Multi-face cards store 'Face A // Face B' in cards.name, each face's own name in cards.faceName, and cards.side 'a', 'b', ...; side is NULL for single-faced cards.
Color letters in cards.colors / colorIdentity: 'W' white, 'U' blue, 'B' black, 'R' red, 'G' green; multicolor is comma-separated (e.g. 'B,U'); colorless is NULL.
A card with 'incredibly powerful foils' has cards.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cards.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL.
Converted mana cost / mana value is cards.convertedManaCost (REAL); cards.manaCost is the unconverted cost text such as '{5}{W}{W}'.
cards.power and cards.toughness are TEXT: '*' or NULL means unknown, '∞' infinite, and some values are '1+*' or '2.5'.

A card's 'types' are cards.supertypes (e.g. 'Legendary', 'Basic', 'Snow', before the em-dash) plus cards.subtypes (e.g. 'Human,Cleric', after it); cards.types holds main types like 'Artifact,Creature'.
cards.type is the type line with an em-dash ('Creature — Human Cleric'); cards.originalType is the printed type with a hyphen ('Creature - Human Cleric').
Frame style is cards.frameVersion: '1993', '1997', '2003', '2015' or 'future'; cards.frameEffects holds visual effects like 'legendary', 'showcase'.
cards.rarity values: 'common', 'uncommon', 'rare', 'mythic'. cards.availability is a comma-separated list of 'paper', 'mtgo', 'arena', 'dreamcast', 'shandalar'.
cards.originalReleaseDate is TEXT 'YYYY/M/D' (e.g. '2012/12/1') with no zero padding; sets.releaseDate is 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
legalities.status is 'Legal', 'Banned' or 'Restricted' (capitalised); legalities.format is lowercase ('commander', 'legacy', 'vintage', 'modern', ...). Join legalities.uuid = cards.uuid.
foreign_data.name is the card's name in foreign_data.language; join foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid for the English cards.name.
Language values are English names: 'Chinese Simplified', 'Chinese Traditional', 'Portuguese (Brazil)', 'German', 'French', 'Italian', 'Japanese', 'Korean', 'Russian', 'Spanish'.
A set's translated name is set_translations.translation for set_translations.language (join set_translations.setCode = sets.code); translation can be NULL, meaning no translation.
sets.mtgoCode NULL means the set does not appear on Magic: The Gathering Online. sets.isForeignOnly = 1 means the set is only available outside the United States.
rulings.text is a rules ruling for the card with rulings.uuid = cards.uuid; rulings.date is 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
